name.description: The repository's name, its record key.

private.description: Whether to make it private: a space of its own on the organization's PDS, which only its members read. Public when absent.

runners.description: The accounts that run its workflows: those the gateway's appview offers when absent.

description.description: What the repository is, shown under its name.

defaultBranch.description: The branch its HEAD names, without refs/heads/: main when absent.

members.description: The members of the organization who may push to it: on a public one, those anyone may see.

runners.description: Its runners: a private one's can read it.

uninvited.description: Why a private one's runners were not told of it, when they were not.

main.description: Makes the repository as `knotless repo create` does: public unless asked for private, naming the runners given or those the gateway's appview offers, with no branches until the first push.

description: Creates a repository in an organization's account, through the gateway the organization delegated writes to, which makes it as the organization, as `knotless repo create` does. The caller must be an admin of it who joined. Requires a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the gateway's DID, for this method.
